purpose: Teach: マトリックス/パンダ/ウェールズ/マイホーム/ビーム/スピン/うなぎ/デイトレ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの好きな映画、マトリックスっていうの
lines.en: Sho, you know my favorite movie? It's called The Matrix.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight lift on the title. Speaking to a child you care for — clear but not talking down. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、パンダの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a panda picture book!
lines.style: Bright, direct excitement. Quick attack. Open vowels — not shy. The genuine enthusiasm of a six-year-old sharing something he found. No performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがウェールズ語の話してくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me he speaks Welsh.
lines.style: Interested, slightly impressed tone. Conversational but noting something new about his world. Warm curiosity — connecting with Sho through something about his dad.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお母さんのマイホーム、大好き
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love your home with Mom and Dad.
lines.style: Soft, sincere delivery. No rush. The words come with care — Sho means this. Small, genuine voice. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがビームを使ったゲームしてたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was playing a game with a beam.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Slight intrigue in the description — noticing details about his family. Conversational, not over-performing. Speaking to a child about his dad.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、コマがスピンするおもちゃ好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like that toy with the spinning top!
lines.style: Immediate, open enthusiasm. Bright attack. Sho's voice — unfiltered joy about something concrete. Quick, genuine beat.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがうなぎ屋に連れて行ってくださるの
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is going to take you to the eel restaurant.
lines.style: Animated, warm anticipation. Light lift — this is something nice coming. Speaking to a child about something exciting. Conversational but with gentle energy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、デイトレってお父さんが言ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said something about day trading — what does that mean?
lines.style: Curious, direct question. Slight hesitation before the ask — Sho noticed a word and is asking. Natural cadence, genuine wondering. Not performed.
